AscendedFrog posted a thesis on $FEELSGOOD: Call me crazy, but I think $FEELSGOOD is every bit as culturally important as $ZCAT and I think the market is overlooking something significant about it as usual. 

We watched $ZEC go parabolic, and $ZCAT became a cultural phenomenon alongside it. An insanely talented community of artists, creators, and believers rallied behind it and the result was $ZCAT reaching escape velocity and becoming more than just another coin. (it’s been incredible to watch)

Now look at $FEELSGOOD 

$PEPE hasn’t even had its next major leg up, yet we’ve already built a passionate community around one of the most recognizable memes in internet history. We’re tapping into the culture BEFORE the catalyst and that’s what makes this so interesting to me personally.

The reflexivity of these pairings is something I think people are seriously underestimating. Especially when we get our first little taste of bull market volume and I think the cultural angle goes much deeper.

The thing about culture is that you can’t manufacture it. You can launch a token, you can pay influencers and you can manufacture hype.

But you cannot buy genuine community.

I’ve watched people pour their time, creativity, and energy into $FEELSGOOD through some incredibly difficult market conditions and they’re still here everyday showing up. That matters more to me than any short-term price action.

$FEELSGOOD has been through what has felt like an endless number of battles/challenges and yet we have faced every single one with determination and optimism AND we still remain the #1 $PEPE pair. 

$PEPE is one of the most iconic memes that has ever been produced and Its roots run deep on every corner of the internet and beyond. 

I genuinely believe $ZCAT/$ZEC and $FEELSGOOD/$PEPE could become two of the most culturally significant pairings of the bull run.

thank you for coming to my TED talk

feels good man
